content.user_title: Process CSV Files With Data Cleaning Workflows
content.value_statement: CSV files often contain inconsistent formats, missing values, duplicates, and large datasets. This skill provides practical workflows for parsing, cleaning, transforming, merging, and analyzing CSV data.
actual_capabilities: Read CSV files with pandas, Python csv, JavaScript csv-parser, and Papa Parse examples.
Filter, select, sort, group, pivot, merge, and split CSV datasets.
Clean duplicates, missing values, whitespace, encodings, dates, and common data formats.
Generate summaries, distributions, correlations, outlier checks, and data quality profiles.
Use chunked reading and writing patterns for large CSV files.
Apply csvkit and awk examples for command-line CSV inspection and conversion.
limitations: It provides documented patterns and examples, not a packaged executable CSV application.
It does not verify that third-party libraries are installed in the user environment.
Very large datasets may require a database or distributed processing outside this skill.
Data validation examples need adjustment for each dataset schema and business rule.

use_cases.title: Clean customer exports
use_cases.description: Remove duplicates, normalize emails, validate required fields, and prepare a clean CSV for import.

use_cases.title: Profile data quality
use_cases.description: Summarize missing values, data types, duplicates, unique counts, and outliers before analysis.

use_cases.title: Merge reporting files
use_cases.description: Combine monthly CSV exports, join related tables, and build grouped metrics for reports.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a CSV file
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an unfamiliar dataset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the csv-processor skill to inspect my CSV file. Identify columns, likely data types, missing values, duplicates, and immediate quality issues.

prompt_templates.title: Clean messy records
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a dataset for import or reporting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the csv-processor skill to clean this CSV. Trim whitespace, remove duplicate rows, standardize email casing, handle missing values, and list each transformation.

prompt_templates.title: Build an analysis summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Create business metrics from CSV data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the csv-processor skill to analyze this CSV. Group results by the relevant category, calculate totals and averages, find outliers, and summarize key findings.

prompt_templates.title: Design a repeatable pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for recurring CSV processing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the csv-processor skill to design a repeatable CSV workflow. Include parsing options, validation rules, cleaning steps, merge logic, large-file handling, and output checks.

output_examples.input: A customer CSV has duplicate emails, mixed casing, blank age values, and inconsistent country names.
output_examples.output: The result would describe a cleaning plan, validation checks, normalized fields, duplicate handling, and a clean export strategy.

output_examples.input: A sales CSV needs monthly revenue totals, top products, missing value checks, and outlier detection.
output_examples.output: The result would provide grouped metrics, data quality notes, suspicious values, and recommendations for a report-ready dataset.

output_examples.input: Several regional CSV files need to be combined and joined with a customer lookup table.
output_examples.output: The result would outline merge keys, join type choices, schema alignment checks, and validation steps for the combined file.

best_practices: Profile the CSV before transforming it, including data types, missing values, duplicates, and encoding.
Test transformations on a small sample before processing the full dataset.
Keep an unchanged copy of source files and document every transformation step.
anti_patterns: Do not assume delimiters, encodings, headers, or date formats without inspection.
Do not overwrite source CSV files before validating the transformed output.
Do not use row filters or joins without checking record counts before and after processing.

faq.question: Can this skill handle large CSV files?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes chunked reading and writing patterns, but very large datasets may need a database.

faq.question: Does it support Python and JavaScript workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for pandas, the Python csv module, csv-parser, Papa Parse, and csv-writer.

faq.question: Can it detect delimiters and encodings?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes delimiter detection, common encodings, and strategies for resolving encoding errors.

faq.question: Can it generate data quality reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers summaries for missing values, duplicates, data types, unique counts, statistics, and outliers.

faq.question: Does it include command-line CSV tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents csvkit and awk examples for inspection, filtering, conversion, statistics, and simple aggregation.

faq.question: Does it automatically modify my files?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides guidance and examples. Any file reads or writes should be requested and reviewed by the user.
